description: Test suite for CSI volume mounter and unmounter in Kubernetes, including setup, teardown, FSGroup support, and service account token handling.

classes.name: mockVolumeOwnershipChanger
classes.description: Mock implementation of volume ownership changer for testing permission change error handling.

methods.name: prepareVolumeInfoFile
methods.description: Prepares a volume info file at the specified mount path with given parameters.

methods.name: TestMounterGetPath
methods.description: Tests that the GetPath method returns the correct volume path.

methods.name: TestMounterSetUp
methods.description: Tests the SetUp method of the CSI mounter, including volume attachment, mounting, and data file creation.

methods.name: TestMounterSetupJsonFileHandling
methods.description: Tests handling of JSON volume info files during setup, including error scenarios.

methods.name: TestMounterSetUpSimple
methods.description: Tests basic setup scenarios for persistent and ephemeral volumes, including error handling.

methods.name: TestMounterSetUpWithStatusTracking
methods.description: Tests volume setup with status tracking, including error scenarios and missing secrets.

methods.name: TestMounterSetUpWithInline
methods.description: Tests setup for inline (ephemeral) and persistent volumes with various configurations.

methods.name: TestMounterSetUpFWithNodePublishFinalError
methods.description: Tests setup failure scenarios with final errors during NodePublish.

methods.name: TestUnmounterTeardown
methods.description: Tests the TearDownAt method of the unmounter, including CSI NodeUnpublish call.

methods.name: TestUnmounterTeardownNoClientError
methods.description: Tests teardown failure when CSI client is unavailable.

methods.name: TestPodServiceAccountTokenAttrs
methods.description: Tests handling of service account tokens in volume context and secrets.

methods.name: Test_csiMountMgr_supportsFSGroup
methods.description: Tests support for FSGroup in CSI mount manager based on driver policies and volume specs.

methods.name: TestMounterGetFSGroupPolicy
methods.description: Tests retrieval of FSGroupPolicy from CSIDriver objects.
